Air Liquide, it’s a story of essential molecules. Molecules… Pure, invisible molecules essential to
life, matter, energy.

Oxygen, Nitrogen, Helium, Argon, Hydrogen, CO2

Our technologies help improve our customers’ processes.

Our technologies help reduce CO2 emissions.

Our services contribute to improving quality of life.

We’re tackling the challenges of our time (Digital / Health / Energy).

relevance, leveraging digital.

+5,600 dedicated employees

320 patent applications

3.5bn data points analyzed/day

We build long-term partnerships

80,000 suppliers

+2m customers

~2.3m patients

Hydrogen for industry

## About Fluoride

#### What is Water Fluoridation?

Unlike all other water treatment processes, fluoridation does not treat the water itself, but the
person consuming it. It’s outdated, unnecessary, and harmful.

###### [Read More][69]

[What is Water Fluoridation]
[Fluoridated Water is the Main Source of Fluoride Exposure]

#### Sources of Fluoride

Fluoridated water is the largest source of exposure for most people, but it is not the only source
of exposure to fluoride.

###### [Read More][70]

#### Health Effects of Fluoride

Fluoride is a highly toxic substance that can cause a range of adverse health effects. Certain
members of the public are at particularly high risk of harm.

###### [Read More][71]

[Health Effects of Fluoride]
[Stages of Fluorosis Composition]

#### Evidence of Overexposure:Dental Fluorosis

Fluorosis is a defect of tooth enamel caused by too much fluoride intake during the first 8 years of
life.

# IoT Leader for Enterprises

## **GAO (Global Advanced Operations) Tek Inc.**

GAO (Global Advanced Operations) Tek Inc. is ranked as a top 10 B2B technology provider in the
world. Headquartered in New York City, U.S. and Toronto, Canada, GAO Tek Inc. serves customers
globally while focuses on the U.S. and Canada markets. We sell through our direct tech sales and
tech support workforce, as well as a strong network of partners located in different parts of North
America.

GAO Tek has worked with its sister companies GAO Research Inc., GAO RFID Inc. and its partners to
research, develop and manufacture a wide range of leading technological products for businesses and
institutions worldwide.  Over the course of 3 decades, the GAO Group of companies have been at the
forefront of innovation and have made significant contributions to the global high-tech industry.

## GAO Tek’ Offers the Following Leading-Edge Technology Products

## IoT Hardware

##### Advanced Devices & Sensors

Reliable IoT Hardware for Diverse Applications
From Gateways and End Devices to RFID, BLE, and GPS Trackers, GAO Tek offers an extensive range of
IoT hardware to power your smart systems. Our solutions provide high-performance, low-power, and
long-range connectivity, ensuring efficient data collection and device management.

## IoT Systems

##### Scalable IoT Systems for Data Processing & Analytics

Our IoT Systems integrate cloud platforms, server solutions, and edge computing for real-time
monitoring, data analytics, and AI-driven decision-making. Whether managing IoT sensors, tracking
devices, or automation networks, our systems provide secure and scalable infrastructure for
businesses.

## IoT Guides

##### Expert Knowledge & Resources

Navigate IoT with Comprehensive Guides & Support
GAO Tek provides technical documentation, case studies, and expert insights through our IoT Guides.
Learn about network architectures, deployment strategies, and industry best practices to optimize
your IoT projects and ensure successful implementation.

## IoT Locations 

##### Deploy IoT Solutions Anywhere with Our Regional Expertise

GAO Tek provides IoT infrastructure and services across North America and globally, ensuring
seamless deployment of LoRaWAN, Zigbee, Wi-Fi HaLow, and Cellular IoT solutions. Whether for smart
cities, industrial automation, or enterprise applications, our IoT Locations support large-scale
rollouts with regional compliance and support.

## **Networks**

Fiber optical network, ethernet networks, PSTN, and CATV products and testers.  

## **Environmental**

Testing and measurement equipment for the environmental industry.

## Chemical & Water

Testing and measurement equipment for environmental applications.

## Structural

Testing and measurement equipment for environmental applications.

## Elec

Electronic products and testing and measurement equipment for electronics and electrical
engineering.

## Drones

Commercial and industrial drones.

## Your team has ideas,
## your agents have capabilities,
## HackMD brings them together

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

###### That's where HackMD comes in

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

## Millions build with HackMD's Markdown editor every day

Powering teams around the world, from next-generation startups to established institutions

Real-time editing with multiple cursors, comments, version history, and GitHub sync. Everything your
team already counts on, every day.

* [Comments & mentions][15]
* [Version history][16]
* [Templates][17]
* [GitHub integration][18]
Every edit, every comment, every revision is tracked and recoverable, so your team's thinking isn't
just captured in the final draft but in the full history of how you got there. That means onboarding
someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.
[
Explore features][19]

#### Built for how communities actually work

From hackathons and research groups to open-source projects, study groups, and devnets, HackMD has
been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes
* [Shared workspaces][20]
* [Embeds][21]
* [Slide mode][22]
* Open-source friendly
When your community has a home base where anyone can show up, share what they know, and start
building with each other, that's when things start to take off. HackMD gives your community a place
to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten
contributors or ten thousand.
[
See community stories][23]

#### Give your agents the context they need, without the overhead

Every HackMD note is Markdown all the way down, which means your agents can pull context, reference
docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.
* Pull any note as Markdown via REST API or CLI
* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace
* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown
Markdown content uses up to 80% fewer tokens than the equivalent HTML, so your agents spend their
compute on the actual work, reducing cost for your team.

#### 1M+

Already powering over 1M+ API calls
Teams are using HackMD's API to feed their agents context, automate note creation, and keep
documentation in sync.

HackMD makes it easier to share with the team in concrete, technical details the features and
rationale for a specific component.

Mikerah Quintyne-CollinsFounder of HashCloak and Stoffel Labs

Read the story][13]

## Built for the team, open to your agents

Your workspace, where humans collaborate and agents can keep up

#### Write together, think together, ship together

Real-time editing with multiple cursors, comments, version history, and GitHub sync. Everything your
team already counts on, every day.
* [Live editing with multiple cursors][14]
* [Comments & mentions][15]
* [Version history][16]
* [Templates][17]
* [GitHub integration][18]
Every edit, every comment, every revision is tracked and recoverable, so your team's thinking isn't
just captured in the final draft but in the full history of how you got there. That means onboarding
someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.
[
Explore features][19]

#### Built for how communities actually work

From hackathons and research groups to open-source projects, study groups, and devnets, HackMD has
been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes
* [Shared workspaces][20]
* [Embeds][21]
* [Slide mode][22]
* Open-source friendly
When your community has a home base where anyone can show up, share what they know, and start
building with each other, that's when things start to take off. HackMD gives your community a place
to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten
contributors or ten thousand.
[
See community stories][23]

#### Give your agents the context they need, without the overhead

Every HackMD note is Markdown all the way down, which means your agents can pull context, reference
docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.
* Pull any note as Markdown via REST API or CLI
* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace
* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown
Markdown content uses up to 80% fewer tokens than the equivalent HTML, so your agents spend their
compute on the actual work, reducing cost for your team.

#### 1M+

Already powering over 1M+ API calls
Teams are using HackMD's API to feed their agents context, automate note creation, and keep
documentation in sync.

Read the API docs][24]

** **Welcome to Jayfluoride Private Limited.....a world of FLUORIDES.....

We **Jayfluoride Private Limited** are one of the leading manufacturers of a broad range of
**Fluorine based derivatives**. Based in Gujarat, India, we are known for our global quality
products, competitive prices, consistent quality improvements and timely deliveries. Since **1978**,
we have been doing a profound work in this industry and meeting varied needs of our industrial
clients. Our brand **JAYFLUORIDE **is a synonym of quality amongst FLUORIDE users in India, and
internationally as well. We are a reckoned entity in the industry, and are a preferred
**manufacturer and exporter** of a wide range of **Industrial Fluoride, Silico Fluoride, Bifluoride,
Fluorozirconic Acid, Fluorozirconates & Fluosilicates and Specialty Chemicals**.

Our founder & mentor **Mr. R.D. Maurya**, B.Sc (Hons.), B.Sc (Tech.) and D.P.P.C. (NITIE-Mumbai ),
is well-recognized as a pioneer of FLUORINE industry. With his 45 years of rich industrial
experience, he was the foremost person in India to produce Hydrofluoric Acid through batch process.
Also he was awarded with import substitute award by the Government of India.

We adopt internationally accepted standards and follow **ISO 9001:2008** Quality Management System.
We export to more than 18 countries worldwide including **Europe, USA, African Sub-continent, UAE
**and others.  

Since 2004, we have been one of the largest suppliers of Ammonium Bifluoride to the Oil & Natural
Gas Corporation Ltd., the Largest Indian Oil & Gas Company. Also, we are a major manufacturer of
Sodium Fluoride in India and have capacity of 2000 MT annually, command almost 60% of market share
of FLUORINE products in the Indian marketplace.





** Our Product Range


─
 
─
**Employing advanced technologies, we manufacture and export a wide assortment of chemicals like:
* **Industrial Fluorides:** Ammonium Fluoride, Potassium Fluoride, Potassium Titanium Fluoride,
  Calcium Fluoride, Chromium Fluoride, Nickel Fluoride, Sodium Fluoride, etc.
* **Bifluoride Chemical:** Ammonium Bifluoride, Sodium Bifluoride, Potassium Bifluoride, etc.
* **Silico Fluoride:** Ammonium Silicofluoride, Potassium Silicofluoride, Magnesium Silicofluoride,
  Zinc Silicofluoride, etc.
* **Cryolite Powder:** Sodium Cryolite, Potassium Cryolite, etc.
* **Fluoroborate Solution: **Zinc Fluoroborate Solution, Copper Fluoroborate Solution, Tin
  Fluoroborate Solution, Lead Fluoroborate Solution, Ammonium Fluoroborate, Sodium Fluoroborate,
  Potassium Fluoroborate, etc.
* **Fluorosilicic Acid:** Fluorosilicic Acid - 35%, Fluoroboric Acid - 20%, 45% & 50%,
  Fluorozirconic Acid - 20% & 45%
* **Speciality Chemicals:** Stannous Sulphate, Sodium Stannate, Cobalt Sulphate, Nickel Sulphate,
  etc.

we have been doing a profound work in this industry and meeting varied needs of our industrial
clients. Our brand **JAYFLUORIDE **is a synonym of quality amongst FLUORIDE users in India, and
internationally as well. We are a reckoned entity in the industry, and are a preferred
**manufacturer and exporter** of a wide range of **Industrial Fluoride, Silico Fluoride, Bifluoride,
Fluorozirconic Acid, Fluorozirconates & Fluosilicates and Specialty Chemicals**.

Our founder & mentor **Mr. R.D. Maurya**, B.Sc (Hons.), B.Sc (Tech.) and D.P.P.C. (NITIE-Mumbai ),
is well-recognized as a pioneer of FLUORINE industry. With his 45 years of rich industrial
experience, he was the foremost person in India to produce Hydrofluoric Acid through batch process.
Also he was awarded with import substitute award by the Government of India.

We adopt internationally accepted standards and follow **ISO 9001:2008** Quality Management System.
We export to more than 18 countries worldwide including **Europe, USA, African Sub-continent, UAE
**and others.  

Since 2004, we have been one of the largest suppliers of Ammonium Bifluoride to the Oil & Natural
Gas Corporation Ltd., the Largest Indian Oil & Gas Company. Also, we are a major manufacturer of
Sodium Fluoride in India and have capacity of 2000 MT annually, command almost 60% of market share
of FLUORINE products in the Indian marketplace.

# Messer – Gases for Life

Leading-edge technical expertise, problem solving and innovation, from people you know and trust.

Leading companies across the USA rely on our trusted expertise, cutting-edge technology, world-class
services and solutions. We’ve been a leading provider of industrial and medical gases for
generations. Today we’re part of the world’s largest global and privately-held industrial gases
company, with unrivaled technical development capabilities and agility. Experience the Messer
difference.

[Jens Luehring]

> “Messer offers the best of both worlds: the breadth, capabilities and insights of a major global
> gas corporation – combined with the agility, speed and entrepreneurial spirit of a lean,
> privately-held enterprise. We know the Americas markets very well. Now we are bringing solutions
> to market faster than ever to support our customers.”

Jens Luehring, President & CEO, Messer Americas

## Our Products

Messer offers a full range of industrial, specialty, medical, and laser gases to meet your product
needs – with unwavering focus on safety and supply dependability.

Our experience extends across a wide range of markets, and we take the time to get to know you and
your unique needs. This enables us to create a custom, cutting-edge gas technology solution for your

taken proactive measures to ensure business resiliency and supply continuity in the event of
heightened spread of the virus in this region.  Our business plans are focused on supply stability

Featured Article: [David Trimble][6]
Lord Trimble official portrait, 2018
**William David Trimble, Baron Trimble,** PC (October 15, 1944 - July 24, 2022), was a politician
from [Northern Ireland][7] who served as leader of the Ulster Unionist Party (UUP) and the first
First Minister of Northern Ireland. He shared the 1998 [Nobel Peace Prize][8] with [John Hume][9] of
the Social Democratic and Labour Party. On June 6, 2006, he became a member of the House of Lords as
The Right Honourable William David Trimble by the name, style and title of Baron Trimble, of
Lisnagarvey in the County of Antrim. Although a staunch [Protestant][10] and member of the Orange
Order, Trimble was able to reach across both the religious and the political divide to enter peace
negotiations and to agree a new power-sharing system of governance.
Popular Article: [Ion][11]
The Earth's "plasma fountain," showing [oxygen][12], [helium][13], and [hydrogen][14] ions that gush
into space from regions near the Earth's poles. The faint yellow material above the [North Pole][15]
represents gas lost from Earth into space; the green material is the aurora borealis—or [plasma][16]
energy pouring back into the atmosphere.
An **ion** is an [atom][17], group of atoms, or [subatomic particle][18] with a net electric charge.
An ion with a net positive charge is called a **cation**; one with a net negative charge is called
an **anion**. The atoms of [metals][19] tend to form cations, and the atoms of [nonmetals][20] tend
to form anions, but there are some exceptions. Ions of opposite charges attract each other. When a
cation forms a chemical bond ("ionic bond") with an anion, an **ionic compound** is produced. A body
of ionized matter, or a gas containing a proportion of charged particles, is called a
**[plasma][21]**.
Did you know?

True matriarchal societies were, and are, extremely rare (source: [Matriarchy][22])

personal data. Pursuant to Article 10 on "Obligation to Inform", data controllers are obliged to

Cookies are small text files (letters and numbers) stored on your device by browsers when you visit
websites. These allow the site to recognize your device and remember your preferences and activity
history. Cookies can be first-party (placed by SEÇİL DENTAL) or third-party (served by partners).

* Your browser and operating system
* IP address
* User ID
* Date and time of your visit
* Status of your access
* Usage of website features
* Search keywords you use
* Frequency of your visits
* Language preferences
* Actions taken on the pages

and measure site content, to offer personalized services and advertisements, and for statistical
evaluations. Categories of cookies we use:

  access.

* **Mozilla Firefox:** Open Menu → "Options" → "Privacy & Security" → "Cookies and Site Data" →
  "Manage Data".
* **Safari:** Go to "Preferences" → "Privacy" → "Manage Website Data". Select and remove cookies as
  desired.

compliance purposes:

* IP Address and protocol used
* Volume of transferred data

national regulations (e.g., Law No. 5651). Data may also be processed for business continuity and/or
provided to authorities and contracted service providers in accordance with legal requirements.

history. Cookies can be first-party (placed by SEÇİL DENTAL) or third-party (served by partners).
More information can be found at [aboutcookies.org][2] and [allaboutcookies.org][3].

##### B. Data Collected via Cookies, Purposes of Use & Legal Grounds

Via cookies, our website may collect and process data such as:
* Your browser and operating system
* IP address
* User ID
* Date and time of your visit
* Status of your access
* Usage of website features
* Search keywords you use
* Frequency of your visits
* Language preferences
* Actions taken on the pages

Cookies are used to ensure a stable experience, to remember your choices on next visits, to develop
and measure site content, to offer personalized services and advertisements, and for statistical
evaluations. Categories of cookies we use:
* **Essential Cookies:** Necessary for the website to function properly. Disabling these may impede
  access.
* **Functional Cookies:** Help remember choices such as language, allow sharing to social platforms,
  and enhance feedback functions.
* **Analytics Cookies:** Collect info on how the site is used for improvement purposes (e.g.,
  visited pages, click counts).
* **Marketing Cookies:** Used to provide advertising and campaigns tailored to your interests.

##### C. How to Disable Cookies

Cookies help enhance site functionality. However, you can disable cookies via your browser settings.
This process may vary depending on your device and browser. Find instructions below:
* **Microsoft Edge:** Click the three dots on the top-right, go to "Settings" → "Choose what to
  clear".
* **Google Chrome:** Open Chrome, click "Settings" → "Advanced" → "Privacy and Security" → "Site
  Settings" → "Cookies and site data". Find and remove cookies for a specific site.
* **Mozilla Firefox:** Open Menu → "Options" → "Privacy & Security" → "Cookies and Site Data" →
  "Manage Data".
* **Safari:** Go to "Preferences" → "Privacy" → "Manage Website Data". Select and remove cookies as
  desired.

#### Personal Data Processing According to Processes

When visiting our site, the following personal data may be processed for security and regulatory
compliance purposes:
* Connection time/start & end
* IP Address and protocol used
* Volume of transferred data

These activities are conducted under legal obligations, especially Article 5 of KVKK and relevant
national regulations (e.g., Law No. 5651). Data may also be processed for business continuity and/or
provided to authorities and contracted service providers in accordance with legal requirements.

#### Your Rights Regarding Your Personal Data
* To learn if your personal data is processed
* To request information if your personal data has been processed
* To find out the purpose of processing and whether your data is used accordingly
* To know third parties to whom your data is transferred
* To request correction if your data is incomplete or incorrect
* To request deletion or destruction when processing reasons cease to exist
* To request notification of such changes to third parties, if data transfer occurred
* To object to a result against you produced by exclusively automatic systems
* To demand compensation in case of unlawful processing and damages

#### Application Procedure

Please send your application by:
* Writing to: Yenigün Mahallesi Yunus Emre Caddesi No:83D Muratpaşa/ANTALYA
* Emailing with a secure e-signature or mobile signature to: secilads@hs01.kep.tr
* Emailing from your registered address to: [info@secildentalclinic.com][4]

nationality/passport or ID number), address for notifications, contact information, and your

# Creatively
# *Ingenious.*

Engineering, procurement, fabrication and construction — turnkey heavy industrial solutions from
Mumbai, India since 1979.

[ Products & Services ][1] [Our Capabilities][2]
— Who We Are

## About Sudhir Brothers

Established in 1979, from the humble beginning to a remarkable stage we are now in the field of
fabrication of equipment and plants. We enjoy continued success due to our work ethics. As one of
the leading companies in Mumbai, providing a full line of engineering, procurement, fabrication,
construction, services to the oil & gas, petrochemical, Nuclear, power generation, marine, and heavy
industries — providing one stop shopping for turnkey projects.

### A New Chapter in Engineering Excellence

In 2025, Sudhir Brothers (SB) and Gururaja Precitech Industries (GPI) joined forces, combining SB's
expertise in heavy fabrication with GPI's specialization in precision machining. This strategic
merger has created a powerful synergy — expanding our product portfolio, strengthening our
capabilities in the power sector, and reaffirming our commitment to delivering advanced,
future-ready engineering solutions for an evolving industry.

[ Learn More ][4]
— What We Stand For

## Our Promise

Strong project management skills ensuring seamless delivery from start to finish.

On-time delivery with an exceptional record of over 95% across all projects.

A versatile 33,000 sq. feet facility with sophisticated, state-of-the-art machinery.

Manufacturing equipment ranging from 10 MT to 250 MT with equal ease.

An agile and flexible team with strong in-house engineering capabilities.

— What We Build

## Products & Services

A complete portfolio of engineered solutions for the world's most demanding industrial sectors.

Established in 1979, from the humble beginning to a remarkable stage we are now in the field of
fabrication of equipment and plants. We enjoy continued success due to our work ethics. As one of
the leading companies in Mumbai, providing a full line of engineering, procurement, fabrication,
construction, services to the oil & gas, petrochemical, Nuclear, power generation, marine, and heavy
industries — providing one stop shopping for turnkey projects.

### A New Chapter in Engineering Excellence

In 2025, Sudhir Brothers (SB) and Gururaja Precitech Industries (GPI) joined forces, combining SB's
expertise in heavy fabrication with GPI's specialization in precision machining. This strategic
merger has created a powerful synergy — expanding our product portfolio, strengthening our
capabilities in the power sector, and reaffirming our commitment to delivering advanced,
future-ready engineering solutions for an evolving industry.

### Dental Volumetric Tomography

is required. Dental tomography provides three-dimensional imaging of the jaw and facial region and

Panoramic radiography is a technique that displays the lower and upper jaws, teeth and adjacent
anatomical structures in a single image. Its main advantage is the low radiation dose. It is used to
identify jaw fractures, the position of wisdom teeth, large lesions and bone diseases.

### What Causes Dry Mouth?

Dry mouth is a condition where there is not enough saliva in the mouth and can be caused by many
different factors, including dehydration, medication, certain medical conditions, the aging process
and cancer treatments. It can be managed by increasing fluid intake, using products that promote
saliva production and practicing regular oral care.

[What Causes Dry Mouth?]

### What is Pregnancy Gingivitis?

**Pregnancy gingivitis **is a common condition of the gums during pregnancy and is often associated
with hormonal changes. Increased levels of estrogen and progesterone in the body during pregnancy
can increase blood flow to the gums, which can cause tenderness, swelling, redness and even
bleeding. Even simple oral hygiene practices, such as brushing or flossing, can lead to gum
irritation more easily. This is particularly common during the second and third trimesters of
pregnancy, as hormone levels are at their highest.

[What is Pregnancy Gingivitis?]

### How to Remove Black Stains on Teeth?

Black stains on teeth can often be due to various causes. They can often be caused by poor oral
hygiene, smoking, excessive consumption of colored beverages such as coffee or tea, oral health
problems or minor cracks in tooth enamel. It is important to consult a dentist to determine the
cause of black spots on teeth.

[How to Remove Black Stains on Teeth?]

### What is Pregnancy Gingivitis?

**Pregnancy gingivitis **is a common condition of the gums during pregnancy and is often associated
with hormonal changes. Increased levels of estrogen and progesterone in the body during pregnancy
can increase blood flow to the gums, which can cause tenderness, swelling, redness and even
bleeding. Even simple oral hygiene practices, such as brushing or flossing, can lead to gum
irritation more easily. This is particularly common during the second and third trimesters of
pregnancy, as hormone levels are at their highest.

[What is Pregnancy Gingivitis?]

### How to Remove Black Stains on Teeth?

Black stains on teeth can often be due to various causes. They can often be caused by poor oral
hygiene, smoking, excessive consumption of colored beverages such as coffee or tea, oral health
problems or minor cracks in tooth enamel. It is important to consult a dentist to determine the
cause of black spots on teeth.

### Fentanyl Molecule -- One of the most dangerous drugs

The high potency of **fentanyl **greatly increases risk of overdose, especially if a person who uses
drugs is unaware that a powder or pill contains it. They can underestimate the dose of opioids they
are taking, resulting in overdose. Two milligrams of fentanyl can be lethal depending on a person’s
body size, tolerance and past usage. DEA analysis has found counterfeit pills ranging from .02 to
5.1 milligrams (more than twice the lethal dose) of fentanyl per tablet. 42% of pills tested for
fentanyl contained at least 2 mg of fentanyl, considered a potentially lethal dose. [**Read more--
see molecule in 3D**][13]

 

### [fentanyl molecule]



### Naloxone Molecule -- -(Narcan) -- Saves Lives

[**Naloxone**][14] (Narcan) is a medicine that can be given to a person to reverse a fentanyl
overdose. Naloxone is a lipophilic compound that acts as a non-selective and competitive opioid
receptor antagonist. Naloxone knocks opioids off their receptors in the brainstem. Naloxone can
restore the drive to breathe, and save a life. But even if naloxone is successful, opioids are still
floating around, so expert medical care should be sought as soon as possible.--Note: Naloxone works
for 30-90 minutes before the opioids return to their receptors. [**Read more**][15]** -** see
Molecule in 3D.
